one_liner: CivicState is a code-backed civic-letter prototype, but investability waits on paid conversion and delivery proof.
directive: Upgrade CivicState's soul to VC-grade scrutiny while preserving workspace evidence and labeling all unsupported market claims as assumptions.

authority.adoption: POM soul-review + wrk.dog merge constitute adoption — operator ruling 2026-06-12; see the PR's POM record

sources.method: Existing product thesis, pricing, validation gates, constraints, and risks
Original assumptions, value chain, distribution hypothesis, moat hypothesis, and success metrics
Existing phase narrative and build claims
Architecture, business model, platform plan, compliance posture, and phased build plan
Current source reality for API, frontend, worker agents, payment, delivery, and admin surfaces

research.honestyRule: Repo and registry files are evidence; external market claims are assumptions.

planningMethod.approach: Evidence-first EIR review: preserve true existing plan, compare against source reality, tag unsupported market claims, and downgrade unsupported investability.
surpriseSpikes: Root soul files were missing while .planning and source code were substantial.
.planning/existing-state.md says zero application code exists, but apps/, packages/shared/, and tests/ contain a substantial prototype.
Registry watchlist note conflicts with prior business-forward framing; upgraded soul treats the asset as research until validation.

customer.icp: US resident with a specific civic concern, desired outcome, and ZIP code who wants a researched constituent letter sent to the right officials.

market.method: Bottom-up behavioral model using assumed eligible residents, campaign frequency, and repo pricing.

tam.basis: 25,000,000 reachable US adults x 1.2 campaigns/year x $14 blended ARPP
tam.label: assumption

sam.basis: 250,000 SEO/social-reachable residents x 0.4 campaigns/year x $14 blended ARPP
sam.label: assumption

som.basis: 12,000 paid submissions/year x $14 blended ARPP by year 3
som.label: assumption

market.evidenceLimit: Repo supports pricing, not demand volume.

unitEconomics.labels: assumption model except repo pricing and planning fixed-cost evidence

revenueAssumptions: Blended ARPP stays $14 from a 35%/$5, 40%/$15, 25%/$25 mix.
Paid submissions average 120/month in 2026, 400/month in 2027, and 1,000/month in 2028.
costAssumptions: AI and research cost averages $0.60 per paid submission.
Payment and delivery variable cost averages $0.76 per paid submission.
Fixed ops begin near $132.50/month and rise with managed services.

holes: No evidence that consumers will pay instead of using free alternatives or doing nothing.
Official email deliverability may fail and create spam/reputation risk.
Legal-adjacent user content may require more human review than the model allows.
Official data quality and local coverage may not meet the product promise.
WrkPlug target posture conflicts with current standalone implementation.
mitigations: Seeded deliverability testing before public paid launch.
Strict moderation, human review, and opt-out enforcement.
Operator decision on WrkPlug migration before more platform work.
residualRisks: Government recipients may reject or suppress platform-generated letters.
Compliance burden could exceed solo-operator capacity.

strategy.positioning: Research-backed constituent communication, not legal advice or lobbying.
strategy.nearTerm: Validate paid beta and delivery before adding features.
strategy.moat: Potential future compounding officials directory, citation library, and public campaign archive; no current durable moat.

goToMarket.secondary: opt-in SEO pages after privacy/moderation validation
notPlanned: API access before consumer loop works
firstValidationTargets: 20 recruited pilot users by 2026-07-31 [assumption: manual pilot target]
2 paid checkouts by 2026-08-31 [assumption: 4% beta conversion target]

operatorWorkflow.routine: Monitor flagged submissions, queue health, treasury reconciliation, delivery failures, and official opt-outs.

constraints: Registry watchlist: personal/research asset, not near-term investible BOS.
No network research used; external claims are assumptions.
Civic communications only; not legal advice, legal filings, lobbying firm activity, or harassment.
Standalone Clerk/Stripe/Postmark implementation exists despite WrkPlug-client target posture.

rules: AI may only cite sources returned by search clients.
Letters include AI disclosure and not-legal-advice language.

assumptionLedger.claim: Consumers will pay $5-$25 for researched civic letters.

assumptionLedger.basis: Modeled tier mix over repo pricing.

assumptionLedger.claim: SEO can become the primary acquisition channel.
assumptionLedger.test: Search impressions and conversions from opt-in pages.
